cert/jobs.mjs (5.3.0-11, Killed since -12): in an interactive pty, ^C typed right after Enter interrupts the new job 20/20 (rc 130); ^Z stops it 20/20 ('Stopped'), and `kill -KILL %1` on each stopped job (no SIGCONT) is reported 'Killed' 20/20.
